description: This file defines the EntityConfig class, which models and loads the configuration of entity components from an XML file (entityengine.xml). It acts as a singleton managing various configuration elements such as resource loaders, delegators, entity readers, data sources, and more, used throughout the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityConfig
classes.description: Singleton class that loads and manages entity-related configurations from the entityengine.xml file, providing access to resource loaders, entity readers, data sources, and other configuration elements.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EntityConfig.

methods.name: getResourceLoader
methods.description: Retrieves a ResourceLoader by name from the configuration.

methods.name: getResourceLoaderList
methods.description: Returns the list of resource loaders configured.

methods.name: getDatasource
methods.description: Retrieves a Datasource configuration by name.

methods.name: getDatasourceMap
methods.description: Returns a map of all Datasources.

methods.name: createConfigFileLineNumberText
methods.description: Produces a string indicating the line number of an XML element within the source file, if available.

methods.name: getJdbcPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the JDBC password for an InlineJdbc element, handling properties lookup if necessary.
